items.title: Nord Stream trial opens in Germany, defense seeks dismissal
items.description: Serhii Kuznietsov is accused of attacking civilian infrastructure in the 2022 sabotage of the Russian gas pipeline to Germany. His lawyers called Nord Stream a military target, and said their client is sworn to secrecy.

items.title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
items.description: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.

items.title: What if you could turn off your algorithm? Australia is about to try
items.description: New legislation is being tabled in Australia's parliament on Thursday to force big tech to allow users to switch off algorithms which send them recommended content.

items.title: India news: Supreme Court hears Rahul Gandhi's Election Commission plea
items.description: A petition filed by opposition leader Rahul Gandhi and others seeks an independent audit of India's sweeping voter deletions. Meanwhile, actor Imran Khan has reportedly been ordered to leave India.
